english_translation: Mother said, "Come here now and help me."
grammar_notes: Concordial Agreement (Zvivakashure): Notice how 'Amai' establishes the noun class/subject frame (Mupanda 1a/2a Honorific Kinship Noun).
Agglutinative Morphology: 'undibatsire' combines prefixal/suffixal morphemes (Ø- (Cl. 5/9) + -undibatsire (root)) with tone contour H-L-H-L.
Penultimate Lengthening: In Zezuru declarative sentences, the second-to-last syllable of the phrase carries natural vowel lengthening.
cultural_notes: In Harare Zezuru standard speech, speakers maintain strict alliterative concord (zvivakashure) across noun classes while using respectful plural forms (hunhu).
